messages:
sam_partnerships: Heads-up team 13 14: were starting a preflight for the 3-cloud marketplace listings. Need quick owners + a <48h checklist so we can get QA to validate. Items: publisher IDs, tax forms (W-8/W-9), infra entitlements, container/VM artifacts, security contact, and marketing collateral.

julia_cp: I can take publisher IDs + store listing text. Will need final logo assets (svg/png) and short/long descriptions. Can someone confirm trademark line for legal?

anika_security: I'll own security contact, CVE disclosure entry, and minimum-hardened image checklist. Also: require a signed SOC/ISO attestation before public listing. Any objections?

mike_cloudops: I'll handle artifacts. Plan: push container image to our Marketplace Registry (mkt-reg.redwood.internal), bake Azure managed image, create AWS AMI snapshot, and publish a GCP marketplace VM image. Need a small test cluster for license token validation.

sam_partnerships: marketplace-bot, generate a sandbox publisher ID + a sandbox marketplace test account for each cloud please.

marketplace-bot: Created sandbox IDs.
- aws_pub_1837_sbx
- gcp_pub_1837_sbx
- az_pub_1837_sbx
Sandbox accounts: https://sandbox.marketplace.redwood/internal/1837 (credentials in vault).

julia_cp: Quick question: do we have to supply a usage metering endpoint for GCP? I remember GCP supports both license API and metering.

mike_cloudops: GCP requires a metering API for usage-based billing; AWS can use metered product or private offers. We'll expose a simple /meter POST endpoint behind the entitlement service. Dev will stub with test tokens.

anika_security: Ensure the /meter endpoint only logs minimal data: product_id, customer_id hash, and quantity. No raw prompt data in logs. Add to checklist.

sam_partnerships: Also: tax/seller forms need to be completed before we can accept revenue. Finance owns submitting W-9/W-8. @finance-team please advise on timeline. (p.s. copying Kathryn offline)

julia_cp: Draft listing copy: short: "Redwood Inference 1-high throughput LLM inference platform, pay-as-you-go or reserved." Long: "Bring predictable latency and flexible deployment to your apps. Available on AWS, GCP, and Azure marketplaces with seat and instance licensing. Includes dedicated support and SLA options." Please review.

anika_security: Minor wording: change "pay-as-you-go" to "metered billing" and remove any language promising SLA specifics unless we have sign-off.

julia_cp: Updated.

mike_cloudops: Artifact names for this run:
```
redwood-inference:1.4.0-marketplace (container image)
ami-redwood-inference-2026-03-20
gcp-image-redwood-2026-03-20
azure-vhd-redwood-2026-03-20
```
We'll attach manifest and sha256 checksums to the listing.

marketplace-bot: Validation report (sandbox):
- Container image scan: 3 low findings, 0 medium/high.
- AMI build: success.
- GCP image: success.
- Metadata schema: missing support_contact field.
Please update.

sam_partnerships: @anika_security add support_contact to metadata (security + ops). @julia_cp add marketing support email.

anika_security: Added security@redwood.ai and incident PGP key thumbprint to metadata.

julia_cp: Added support@redwood.ai to listing metadata. Also attached logos to the sandbox listing.

mike_cloudops: Running e2e: deploy AWS AMI -> bootstrap with license token -> call /meter with test token -> check billing record. Will post results in 2 hours.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: Azure needs a publisher agreement step. See docs: https://marketplace.redwood/docs/azure-publisher.

sam_partnerships: Thanks. Anyone see blockers? If not, we try to go public next week after finance/tax sign-off and SOC attestation.

mike_cloudops: E2E pass on sandbox: license accepted, /meter recorded qty=1, billing record created (sandbox id mapped). No blocking issues.

anika_security: SOC attestation inbound, ready by Fri. I verified no sensitive logs in /meter and image scan acceptable.

julia_cp: Marketing approves screenshots and copy. Legal to confirm publisher agreement clause re: indemnity.

sam_partnerships: Perfect. I'll update the preflight checklist and schedule the final publish window. Will open a brief follow-up thread for launch coordination. :rocket:
